name: mParticle
description: mParticle is a customer data platform for collecting, governing, resolving, and activating customer data across applications and downstream services. Its Platform API includes account, workspace, Real-time Audience, data-planning, integration, and administrative resources.
agentUseSummary: Add customer-owned mParticle Platform API client credentials and bind one exact account and workspace; agents can read only an identity-free Real-time Audience readiness aggregate.

credentialRequirements.name: MPARTICLE_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: mParticle Platform API client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated least-privilege Platform API credential for the customer account. Relay encrypts the binding and uses it only for the documented client-credentials token exchange.

credentialRequirements.name: MPARTICLE_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: mParticle Platform API client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the matching customer-owned secret. Relay encrypts it and never exposes it or the short-lived bearer token to agents.

credentialRequirements.name: MPARTICLE_ACCOUNT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: mParticle account ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind one exact positive numeric account ID at connection time; agents cannot select another account.

credentialRequirements.name: MPARTICLE_WORKSPACE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: mParticle workspace ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Bind one exact positive numeric workspace ID at connection time; agents cannot select another workspace.

capabilities.label: Read audience readiness summary
capabilities.description: Aggregate active, calculated, and connected Real-time Audience counts for one exact account and workspace while excluding all audience identity, size, membership, creator, workspace, and output details.

approvalRequired.label: Get mParticle audience readiness summary
approvalRequired.description: Return only returned, active, calculated, and connected counts from the exact bound workspace's Real-time Audience response.

blocked.label: Access audience identity, size, or membership
blocked.description: Audience IDs, names, external names, sizes, membership, additions, removals, definitions, calculations, creators, modifiers, and timestamps remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access profiles, identities, events, or attributes
blocked.description: MPIDs, users, profiles, identities, devices, events, data points, attributes, consent, locations, sessions, and raw customer data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access outputs, inputs, or workspace details
blocked.description: Output provider/configuration names, destinations, inputs, feeds, services, apps, account/workspace names and metadata, credentials, and delivery state remain blocked.

blocked.label: Create, update, delete, or administer mParticle
blocked.description: Audience deletion, data-plan changes, integrations, keys, users, roles, accounts, workspaces, transformations, warehouse sync, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary accounts, workspaces, origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, filters, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, Events/Profile/Identity APIs, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The bounded audience readiness read requires approval; identity, profiles, events, audience detail, integrations, writes, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded read runs directly; account/workspace binding, short-lived token exchange, redaction, response cap, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed account/workspace-bound identity-free mParticle Audience readiness wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed mParticle wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: mParticle Platform API access requires an eligible customer account, a dedicated credential with sufficient read permission, exact account/workspace IDs, Real-time Audiences access, and live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer admin confirms entitlement, creates a dedicated least-privilege Platform API credential, supplies exact account/workspace IDs, and completes a live read-only acceptance check.

evidence.supports: mParticle documents the fixed Platform API and SSO origins, client-credentials JSON token exchange, approximately eight-hour bearer tokens, account query binding, versioned API paths, and status behavior.

mParticle documents the workspace-bound GET /v1/workspace/{workspaceId}/audiences?accountId={accountId} endpoint for active Real-time Audiences and its rich identity, size, workspace, and connected-output response fields.
mParticle documents customer-managed Platform API credentials, client ID/secret and workspace binding, and internal generation of bearer tokens for Platform API services.

securityNotes: Relay encrypts the customer-owned client ID, client secret, exact account ID, and exact workspace ID; the secret is sent only to the documented mParticle SSO token endpoint.

Relay exchanges credentials using the fixed client_credentials grant and audience https://api.mparticle.com; the short-lived bearer token is used only for the immediately following fixed read and is never returned or persisted.

Relay allowlists only GET /v1/workspace/{bound-workspace}/audiences?accountId={bound-account}, rejects redirects, waits 30 seconds per request, caps token and API responses at 1 MB, and never accepts runtime selectors.
Output contains only returned, active, calculated, and connected aggregate counts; audience IDs, names, sizes, changes, creators, timestamps, workspace metadata, and output details are excluded.

Profiles, identities, events, data points, inputs, outputs, services, integrations, data plans, writes, deletion, administration, arbitrary APIs, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.
Provider setup, entitlement confirmation, credential creation, account/workspace selection, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
